title: Site visit: Sigma’s lithium mine operating after restructuring
gist: A July 2026 Benchmark site visit found Sigma Lithium's Grota do Cirilo mine in Brazil operating at full capacity with active blasting, continuous load-and-haul on both pits, and a fully functioning DMS plant, confirming a genuine operational turnaround following the mine's October 2025 pause and a since-resolved government inspection of its waste piles.

insights.claim: Sigma Lithium's Grota do Cirilo mine in Minas Gerais, Brazil, paused operations in October 2025 for upgrades, with the restart further complicated by three waste piles being shut down following a government inspection at the start of 2026 that has since been resolved.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Establishes the operational disruption timeline investors need to model Sigma's 2025-2026 production shortfall and recovery trajectory.
insights.locator: "Sigma Lithium had paused operation at the mine in October 2025..."

insights.claim: Sigma Lithium's self-imposed restructuring, undertaken after a period of operational bottlenecks, produced a significant operational turnaround at the Grota do Cirilo mine, according to Benchmark's site visit findings.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: A company-driven restructuring succeeding operationally is a template for evaluating other junior/mid-tier lithium producers facing bottleneck-driven underperformance.
insights.locator: "The visit also offered a chance to see on the ground..."

insights.claim: Benchmark's July 2026 site visit to Sigma Lithium's Grota do Cirilo operation came just before the company reported its strongest operating quarter in over a year.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Timing corroborates that the on-the-ground recovery observed by Benchmark's analyst preceded, and lines up with, Sigma's reported operating results — a validation signal for the turnaround thesis.

insights.claim: The explicit purpose of Federico Gay's mid-July site visit was to establish whether Sigma Lithium's mining restart had genuinely taken hold, rather than to take management's recovery narrative at face value.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Illustrates Benchmark's independent verification methodology (site visits versus company guidance) — a diligence lens investors can apply to other mining restart claims.
insights.quote: establish whether the mining restart had genuinely taken hold
insights.locator: "Federico Gay, Benchmark's principal lithium analyst, visited the site mid-July..."

insights.claim: Federico Gay, Benchmark's principal lithium analyst, concluded from his mid-July site visit that Sigma Lithium's mine is operating at full capacity, with active blasting and continuous load-and-haul operations on both pits, supported by a fully functioning DMS plant.
insights.speaker: Federico Gay, Benchmark's principal lithium analyst
insights.so_what: First-hand analyst verification of a full-capacity restart is a concrete positive catalyst for Sigma Lithium's production guidance and spodumene supply forecasts.
insights.quote: the mine is operating at full capacity, with active blasting, continuous load and haul operations on both pits, supported by a fully functioning DMS plant, with a clear path of growth ahead.
